## AdaptiveCurveIrmLib.WEXP\_UPPER\_BOUND variable

Above this bound, `wExp` is clipped to avoid overflowing when multiplied with 1 ether. This upper bound corresponds to: ln(type(int256).max / 1e36) (scaled by WAD, floored).

**Signature:**

```typescript
WEXP_UPPER_BOUND = 93859467695000404319n
```
